newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos urges end to fighting in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Ramos urges end to fighting in Cambodia.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos called on warring sides in Cambodia on Sunday to end the fighting and resolve their dispute amicably.

"The Philippines hopes that the two sides will settle their disputes peacefully and avoid further violence," Ramos said in a statement after fighting broke out between troops loyal to Cambodia's two rival prime ministers.
Ramos said the Philippine government also hoped Phnom Penh would take measures to ensure the safety of about 500 Filipinos working in Cambodia.
"The Philippine embassy in Phnom Penh is closely monitoring the situation and has advised the members of the Filipino community to stay at home to avoid getting involved in the troubles," Ramos said.
He said the embassy had adopted contingency plans "which it can put into operation if necessary".
